<center># Study 1 codebook raw data
<br>
<br>

Nr.       |Variable Name      | Variable Label            |  Variable Values 
----------|-------------------|---------------------------|-------------------------
1|id|Participant ID|-
2|condition|Experimental condition|1 = Harmonious; 2 = Conflicting
3|random_app|Context name randomization|1 = 1st "Eats", 2nd "Zanana"; 2 = 1st "Zanana", 2nd "Eats"
4|base_tasty_c1|Estimated percentage of tasty foods in 1st context (Base rate)|0%; 100%
5|base_healthy_c1|Estimated percentage of healthy foods in 1st context (Base rate)|0%; 100%
6|base_tasty_c2|Estimated percentage of tasty foods in 2nd context (Base rate)|0%; 100%
7|base_healthy_c2|Estimated percentage of healthy foods in 2nd context (Base rate)|0%; 100%
8|healthy_tasty_c1|Estimated chance of getting a tasty food when ordering a healthy food in 1st context (Conditional probability estimate)|0%; 100%
9|healthy_tasty_c2|Estimated chance of getting a tasty food when ordering a healthy food in 2nd context (Conditional probability estimate)|0%; 100%
10|unhealthy_tasty_c1|Estimated chance of getting a tasty food when ordering an unhealthy food in 1st context (Conditional probability estimate)|0%; 100%
11|unhealthy_tasty_c2|Estimated chance of getting a tasty food when ordering an unhealthy food in 2nd context (Conditional probability estimate)|0%; 100%
12|belief_ht_c1|1st context: Which foods taste better? (Relative contingency belief)|1 = the unhealthy foods; 100 = the healthy foods
13|belief_ht_c2|2nd context: Which foods taste better? (Relative contingency belief)|2 = the unhealthy foods; 100 = the healthy foods
14|belief_ht_overall|Across contexts: Which foods taste better? (Relative contingency belief)|3 = the unhealthy foods; 100 = the healthy foods
15|preference|Across contexts: What kind of food would you more likely order? (Preference)|1 = an unhealthy food; 11 = a healthy food
16|PES_1|Protestant ethic scale item: Anyone who is willing and able to work hard has a good chance of succeeding.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
17|PES_2|Protestant ethic scale item: Our society would have fewer problems if people had less leisure time.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
18|PES_3|Protestant ethic scale item: Money acquired easily is usually spent unwisely.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
19|PES_4|Protestant ethic scale item: Most people who don't succeed in life are just plain lazy.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
20|PES_5|Protestant ethic scale item: A distaste for hard work usually reflects a weakness of character.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
21|PES_6|Protestant ethic scale item: If people work hard enough they are likely to make a good life for themselves.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
22|PES_7|Protestant ethic scale item: Most people spend too much time in unprofitable amusements.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
23|PES_8|Protestant ethic scale item: Life would have very little meaning if we never had to suffer.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
24|PES_9|Protestant ethic scale item: I feel uneasy when there is little work for me to do.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
25|PES_10|Protestant ethic scale item: People who fail at a job have usually not tried hard enough.|0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree
26|PES_11|Protestant ethic scale item: The person who can approach an unpleasant task with enthusiasm is the person who gets ahead. |0 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree"
27|delivery|Frequency of ordering via delivery services|1 = Never; 2 = Rarely; 3 = Sometimes; 4 = Often
28|delivery_taste|Tastiness of food from usually used delivery services|1 = Not at all tasty; 100 = Very tasty
29|delivery_health|Health of food from usually used delivery services|1 = Not at all healthy; 100 = Very healthy
30|weight|Body weight in stones and pounds|-
31|height|Body height in feet and inches|-
32|nutrition|Eating style |1 = Unrestricted; 2 = Pescetarian; 3 = Vegetarian; 4 = Vegan; 5 = Other
33|allergy|Food allergies or intolerances|1 = Yes; 2 = No
